prompt: Edit this existing oil painting into a MUCH MORE ABSTRACT oil painting. Keep only a distant suggestion of a group of people with smart glasses / immersive headsets in an uncertain future city. Dissolve all identifiable faces, eyes, mouths, fingers, clothing details and specific architecture into bold, large, irregular planes and gestures. The result should be predominantly abstraction, with five shadow-like vertical human presences and a few dark curved visor-like strokes as faint clues. No realistically rendered faces. No photographic detail. Large palette-knife sweeps, thick impasto, scraping, dragged dry brush, broken geometry and layered pigment on canvas. Strong rhythm and negative space; avoid a uniform tiny brushstroke filter. Restrained charcoal, black, cold blue-grey and dirty ivory, with very sparse muted ochre. Museum-quality nonliteral contemporary oil painting, contemplative and unsettling. Preserve the wide landscape format and the overall dark atmosphere, but radically simplify and deconstruct the original composition. No text, logos, symbols or watermarks.
